subject: english-literature
title: I, You, They
welcome_lead: Three little pronouns choose how close the reader stands to the action.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on first, second and third person narration.
final_note: You can now name the narrative voice from the pronouns alone.

concepts.def: Word replacing a noun (he, she, I).
How close the reader feels to action.

walkthroughs.body_html: First person feels intimate: 'I ran into the rain.' We hear thoughts directly and see only what the narrator sees.
Second person uses 'you' to place the reader in the story. Rare in novels, common in game books and instructions.
Third person uses 'he/she/they', giving a wider, more flexible view of the story world.
